items.quote: we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum
items.statement: FY26 revenue of at least INR 4,000 crore including Q4
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year
items.statement: Consolidated operating cash flow positive by end of FY26
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: At a consol level, we'll definitely deliver this number of $1 billion.
items.statement: Consolidated revenue of USD 1 billion in FY28, with individual targets possibly higher
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent
items.statement: Further capex of about INR 400 crore in the rest of FY26
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: we'll spend about cumulatively INR1,400 crores in the PC Board business
items.statement: Cumulative PC Board capex of INR 1,400 crore in FY27 (Phase 1 completed)
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: which will total up to about between INR700 crores and INR800 crores of smart metering business for the year
items.statement: Smart metering revenue of INR 700-800 crore in FY26
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

items.quote: we are not going to implement any more capex in the EMS business
items.statement: No EMS capex beyond committed numbers; only debottlenecking spend
items.speaker: Jairam Sampath

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management commits to revenue above INR 4,000 crore, consolidated OCF positivity and USD 1 billion revenue in FY28, while declining to give quarterly guidance because a railway product was postponed.
